title: Search for a process by name
summary: Find a specific running process by searching for its name or command string. This filters the process list to show only matching entries.

steps.explain: List all processes and filter the output using grep. The brackets around the first letter prevent grep from matching its own command line.

placeholders.name: STRING
placeholders.description: The name or part of the command of the process you are looking for. Use brackets around the first letter, e.g., [c]hrome.

steps.expect: Lines from the process list that contain the search string.
